race.title: William Hill Challenge Series Irish EBF Beginners Chase
race.verdict: ROSIE'S WINGS may well have made a successful chasing debut had he not made a late mistake at Fairyhouse recently, so Ross O'Sullivan's 6-y-o earns the vote to go one better with improvement likely. Having finished runner-up on sole start in points, Kaiser de Chanay heads up the dangers on chasing bow back from 7 months off, with Some Song and Speculateur another couple worth considering, too. ROSIE'S WINGS (IRE) KAISER DE CHANAY (FR) SOME SONG (IRE)
